status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.

tasks.title: Define favorite preset implementation plan
tasks.targets: design notes in this checklist, then app/js/app.js and app/css/style.css if implemented
protected_fields: current favorite set until migration behavior is decided
tasks.summary: Decide the smallest useful preset feature: save current favorites as a named preset, switch presets, and restore favorites from the selected preset.
verify: Plan states whether presets replace or merge with current favorites.
Plan states localStorage key shape.
Plan states how users create, select, rename, and delete presets.
Plan includes mobile space constraints.
tasks.result: Favorite presets are stored per dataset under favoritePresets.${datasetKey}. Applying a preset replaces the current favorite set. Saving creates a named snapshot from current favorites. Deleting a preset removes only the preset and does not delete current favorites. Manual favorite changes clear the active preset selection so users can tell the current set has diverged. Controls are kept in the settings panel as select + save/apply/delete buttons for mobile compactness.
